record.title: Recognize the exact successful helper transfer and bounded socket retirement
record.intent: Correct observed host CLI assumptions while preserving exact helper bytes and cleanup evidence.
requirements: Preserve current04 stopped evidence and known-owner root cleanup. Its stock snapshot passed; the ADB push returned zero with a one-file progress diagnostic that the collector rejected because stderr was nonempty. No reader launch, native change or RF source command followed. Preserve original server exit-status uncertainty, later process/listener/active-peer absence, zero-drop graceful capture and DHCP closure, and the unlaunched staged helper residue.

Accept only a successful zero-return transfer with the exact single-file, zero-skipped progress diagnostic bound to its source and byte count, rejecting other diagnostics or failure. Keep mandatory remote file owner/mode/size and exact round-trip hash before reader launch. Do not replay the stopped push or reuse its stage path.

Record actual owned-server wait status before checking retirement and allow a finite five-second observation-only drain of its TCP closure. Preserve zero exit, listener and active-peer absence requirements, reader lifecycle requirements and TIME_WAIT distinction. Do not start a replacement server, relax nonzero exit status or contact a peer during retirement.

Validate only supplied diagnostics and process observations, independently review exact amended runtime and fresh collector bindings, commit and push before execution. The stopped unlaunched helper is quarantined; any later removal requires exact provenance, owner and byte verification, not guessed cleanup.
acceptance: Successful transfer diagnostics and bounded retirement are represented without weakening exact helper or endpoint checks.
